exposure: FLD status (neither-FLD, NAFLD-only, MAFLD-only, and both-FLDs)
cohort: 762,401 fertile females who underwent health examinations and became pregnant within 1 year of health examination
finding: MAFLD is associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes for both mother and fetus than NAFLD.
mod_finding: Pregnancy outcomes (cesarean delivery, gestational diabetes, and low birthweight) were worse in females with MAFLD compared with NAFLD.
